notes.title: August playtest update
notes.notes: [p]It has been a quiet couple of months since our last online playtest back in June. We've been working hard on this new build, and also on our pitch and preparations for Gamescom. We travel to Germany in less than a weeks time![/p][p] [/p][h3][b]So what's new in this playtest?[/b][/h3][list][*][p]2x new bosses[/p][/*][*][p]Voyage selection screen[/p][/*][*][p]Intro cinematic[/p][/*][*][p]First death "contract signing" scene[/p][/*][*][p]Save system improvements[/p][/*][*][p]A dedicated "insult" button[/p][/*][*][p]'Combo': a new enemy status effect[/p][/*][/list][p]There are also 3+ new Steam achievements to unlock! Share your progress with the crew in our [b][url="https://discord.gg/Es3BsqFHxH"]discord channel[/url].[/b][/p][p] [/p][h3][b]Accessing the playtest[/b][/h3][p]If you would like to play, please fill out this [b][url="https://forms.gle/4RetBqykPNTjbVRU9"]sign up form[/url][/b] to get sent a key.[/p]
